```{r setup}
library("hlebuhanec.0325")
library("GimmeMyStats")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("RColorBrewer")
library("rlist")
library("ggrepel")
library("kableExtra")
library("cowplot")
library("janitor")
library("naniar")
library("openxlsx")
data("clinic2")

path_fig <- file.path(getwd(),  knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.path"))
```

```{r}
table(clinic2$groupe) %>%
    enframe(name = "Group", value = "N") %>%
    kable0()

func_format <- function(x) {
  str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>%
  str_to_sentence() %>%
  str_replace_all("micro l", "\\(ml\\)") %>%
  str_replace_all("mm3", "\\(mm3\\)")
}

select(clinic2, -ipp) %>%
  write_statistics(file = file.path(path_fig, "statistics.xlsx"), format = function(x) func_format(x))
```

## Demography
```{r, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 8}
list.map(
  unique(clinic2$groupe),
  f(x) ~ {
    res <- filter(clinic2, groupe == x) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(sexe)) %>%
    age_pyramid("age", "sexe", seq(0, 100, 10), colour = brewer.pal(4, "Paired")[3:4]) + 
    ggtitle(x) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
  plot(res)
  }) %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 3)
```

```{r}
plot_bar_2cat(
  select(clinic2, "sexe", "groupe"),
  sort = c("HD", "DA", "PN"),
  stats = FALSE
)
filter(clinic2, is.na(sexe)) %>% select(patient)

list.map(
  c("age", "age_au_dg_an"),
  f(x, y) ~ {
    res <- clinic2 %>%
  select(all_of(c(x, "groupe", "patient")))
    if (y == 2)
      res <- filter(res, groupe != "HD")
  pivot_wider(res, names_from = groupe, values_from = !!sym(x)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
  plot_violin(
    colour = palette_discrete()[seq(length(unique(res$groupe)))],
    cex = 1.2,
    pch_size = 3,
    pch_alpha = 0.25,
    coef = 1.5,
    breaks = c(25, 50, 75),
    label = TRUE,
    title = ifelse(y < 2, "Age", "Age at diagnostic")
  )
  }
) %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2)

table_groupe_numeric(clinic2, c("age", "age_au_dg_an"), file.path(path_fig, paste0("stats_age.png")))

filter(clinic2, is.na(age)) %>% 
  select(patient)

filter(clinic2, is.na(age_au_dg_an)) %>% 
    filter(groupe != "HD") %>%
    select(patient)
```

## Timelines
```{r}
date_variables <- find_dates(clinic2)
list.map(
  date_variables,
  f(x, y) ~{
    if (y != 2){
      regex <- "%Y-%m"
    } else {
      regex <- "%Y"
    }
    pull(clinic2, x) %>%
      plot_date(
        func = ymd,
        title = func_format(x),
        regex = regex
      )
  }
)
```

```{r}
list.map(
  unique(clinic2$groupe),
  f(i) ~ {
    res <- filter(clinic2, groupe == i)
  list.map(
    date_variables,
    f(x, y) ~{
      if (y != 2){
        regex <- "%Y-%m"
      } else {
        regex <- "%Y"
      }
      pull(res, x) %>%
        plot_date(
          func = ymd,
          title = paste(i, ":", str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence()),
          regex = regex
        )
    }
  )
  }
)
```

```{r, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 10}
list.map(
  date_variables[-5],
  f(x, y) ~ {
clinic2 %>%
    mutate(
    years = pull(., x) %>% 
        year() %>% as.character()
)  %>%
    select(years, groupe) %>%
    plot_bar_2cat(
        sort = c("HD", "DA", "PN"),
        stats = FALSE,
        threshold_pct = 10,
        title = func_format(x)
    ) -> res
  }
) %>% plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
p <- list.map(
  find_dates(clinic2)[-5],
  f(x, y) ~ {
    print(x)
    if(y %in% c(3, 4)) {
      res <- filter(clinic2, groupe != "HD")
    } else {
      res <- clinic2
    }
    if (y == 1) {
      res <- res %>%
      mutate(
        days = pull(., all_of(x)) %>% 
        difftime(Sys.Date(), .) %>% 
        as.numeric()
        ) 
    } else {
      res <- res %>%
      mutate(
        days = pull(., all_of(x)) %>% 
        difftime(pull(res, "date_inclusion"), ., units = "days") %>% 
        as.numeric()
        )
    }
    select(res, days, groupe, patient) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = groupe, values_from = days) %>%
    column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
    plot_violin(
      colour = palette_discrete()[seq(length(unique(pull(res, "groupe"))))],
      cex = 1.2,
      pch_size = 3,
      pch_alpha = 0.25,
      coef = 1.5,
      label = TRUE,
      width_text = 20,
      title = func_format(x),
      func_label = label_date,
      ratio_labs = 1
    ) -> res
    plot(res)
  }
)
```

### Errors in age
```{r}
clinic2 %>%
    mutate(
        age_years = as.numeric(difftime(date_inclusion, date_naissance, units = "days")) / 365.25
    ) %>% 
    mutate(diff_age = age_years - age) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("patient") -> res
select(res, diff_age) %>%
    plot_violin(label = TRUE)
filter(res, abs(diff_age)  > 1.5) %>% select(date_naissance, age_years, age, diff_age) %>% kable0(digits = 1)
```

```{r, fig.width = 23, fig.height = 10}
vars0 <- c("pne_mm3", "pnn", "monocytes", "cd4_micro_l", "cd8_micro_l", "ly_b_micro_l", "plaquettes", "creatinine")

func_format2 <- function(x) {
  str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>%
  str_to_upper() %>%
  str_replace_all("MICRO L", "\\(ml\\)") %>%
  str_replace_all("MM3", "\\(mm3\\)") %>%
  str_replace_all("IG", "Ig")
}

  plot_violin_group(

    method = "wilcox",
    display_log = TRUE

plot_grid(plotlist = p[-seq(8)], ncol = 4, align = "hv")
```

## Scores
```{r}
func_format2 <- function(x) {
  str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>%
          str_to_upper() %>%
          str_replace_all("POST TTT", "post-traitement")
}

filter(clinic2, groupe != "HD") %>%
 plot_violin_group(c("dlqi", str_subset(colnames(clinic2), "eva_")), func = func_format2) %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 3)
# [0-30]; [0-10]
# severe: >10; > 6

filter(clinic2, groupe == "DA") %>%
 plot_violin_group(str_subset(colnames(clinic2), "easi_"), func = func_format2) %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = .)
# [0-72]
# severe: >21

list.map(
    str_subset(colnames(clinic2), "iga_"),
    f(x, y) ~ {
        p <- mutate(clinic2, Group = !!sym(x)) %>%
            select(Group, groupe) %>%
            filter(groupe != "HD") %>%
            plot_bar_2cat(
                sort = c("DA", "PN"),
                colour = brewer.pal(6, "Reds")[-1] %>% rev(),
                colour_text = "black",
                legend = clinic2$iga_da %>% levels() %>% rev(),
                stats = FALSE,
                threshold_pct = 15,
                threshold = 1,
                width_title = 20,
                title = func_format2(x)
            )
                if(y != 2)
                  p + theme(legend.position = "none")
                else
                  p
    }
) %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., rel_widths = c(2, 2.75, 2))


x <- "sc_atteinte_percent"
clinic2 %>%
  mutate(clinic2, Group = !!sym(x)) %>%

  plot_bar_2cat(
    sort = c("DA", "PN"),
    colour = brewer.pal(6, "Reds")[-1] %>% rev(),
    colour_text = "black",

    stats = FALSE,
    threshold_pct = 15,
    threshold = 1,
    width_title = 20,
    title = func_format(x) %>% 
      str_replace_all("percent", "\\(%\\)")
)
# severe: > 30
```

## Comorbidities
```{r}
vars <- c(
  "comorbidites",
  "hta",
  "diabete",
  "immunodepression",
  "autres_comorbidites"
)
vars <- c(
  "menopause",
  "ttt_chroniques",
  "atb_1mois",
  "derniere_douche_12h",
  "dernier_emollient_12h"
)
vars1 <- vars[seq(3)]
clinic3 <- select(clinic2, vars, "patient", "groupe") %>%
    rename_with(~str_replace(., "hta", "hypertension") %>% str_replace(., "1", "<1") %>% str_replace("atb", "antibiotique") %>% str_replace("ttt", "traitements"), everything())

select(clinic3, vars1, "groupe") %>%
  plot_bar_2cat_clinic(colnames(.) %>% discard(~str_detect(., "groupe"))) %>% 
    map(~ .x + labs(y = NULL)) %>%
{
  c(map(head(., -1), ~ .x + theme(legend.position = "none")), tail(., 1))
} %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(rep(1, length(vars1) -1), 1.3), align = "h")
```

## Samples
```{r}
vars <- c("pbmc", "serum", "plasma", "biopsie", "numeration", "swab") %>%
      c("dsq", ., paste0(., "_post_ttt"), "dsquame_post_ttt")
clinic2 <- mutate(clinic2, pbmc = pmbc)
list.map(
    vars,
    f(x, y) ~ {
        p <- mutate(clinic2, Group = !!sym(x)) %>%
            select(Group, groupe) %>%
            filter(groupe != "HD") %>%
            plot_bar_2cat(
                sort = c("DA", "PN"),
                legend = c("Yes", "No"),
                colour = palette_discrete()[c(3, 1)],
                colour_text = "black",
                stats = FALSE,
                threshold_pct = 10,
                threshold = 1,
                digits = 0,
                title = func_format(x)
            )
        if(!y %in% c(4, 11)) {
          p + theme(legend.position = "none")
        } else {
          p
        }
    }
) -> p
plot_grid(plotlist = p[seq(7)], ncol = 4, rel_widths = c(rep(2, 3), 2.75))
plot_grid(plotlist = p[-seq(7)], ncol = 4, rel_widths = c(rep(2, 3), 2.75))
```

## Missing variables
```{r}
vis_miss(clinic2) + 
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
)

df_sub <- clinic2 %>%
  filter(groupe != "HD") %>%
  column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
    set_colnames(
      colnames(.) %>% 
        str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
        to_title()
      )

p <- plot_missing(
  df_sub,
  cex = .1,
  all = TRUE,
  sort = "asc",
  width_text = 50,
  label_x = "none",
  factor(df_sub$Groupe, labels = palette_discrete()[seq(2)])
)
plot_missing(
    df_sub,
    cex = .8,
    n_max = 35,
    width_text = 50,
    label_y = "percent",
    threshold1 = nrow(df_sub)/2,
    threshold2 = ncol(df_sub)/2,
    colour = factor(df_sub$Groupe, labels = palette_discrete()[seq(2)])
)
p2 <- plot_outliers(df_sub, cex = 8, n_max = 20)

list.map(
  list(p, p2),
  f(x) ~
    filter(clinic2, patient %in% names(head(x))) %>%
      metada_samples(ids = pull(., "patient"))
)

res <- extract_rare(df_sub) %>% 
    map(~ .x %>% filter(!rownames(.x) %in% "PN09")) %>%
    keep(function(x) nrow(x) > 0) %>%
    map(print_multinomial) %>%
    list.rbind()

res %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Levels)) %>%
    pull(Variables) %>% unique()
```
